messages:
Olivia CSM: Quick async check on GreenBridge — renewal in 3 weeks. They've reported intermittent 502/timeout spikes for webhook deliveries from our EU cluster yesterday afternoon. Adoption metrics dipped 8% on their staging flows. Can we do a quick triage + mitigation?
Maya Support: saw the same alerts, linked errors: https://dash.redwoodinc.com/explore/gb-webhooks (last 24h). Most failures are `504 gateway timeout` from our ingestion gateway to the webhook worker pool.
Sam Eng: looking now. Do we have a recent deploy around the spike? any canary traffic?
deploy-bot: canary-deploy/gb-ingest v2.14.1 started 1835118600 -> rollout 20% -> failing health checks -> paused at 1835119200.
Maya Support: confirmed pause timestamp matches customer reports (~13:20 CET).
Liang Platform: initial hunch: one of the worker autoscale groups hit an OOM and caused backlog — the gateway backpressured and timed out. I see memory pressure on eu1-ingest-3 from 13:05–13:35.
Sam Eng: can you paste the relevant pod logs? also what model routing was active for GreenBridge? (they're using generation + reranker path)
Maya Support: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-16T13:08:12Z ingest-worker[pid=294]: queue_wait_ms=3120 throughput=0.8 errors=0.21
2026-03-16T13:09:01Z ingest-worker[pid=294]: OOMKilled: signal 9
```
Model routing: gb-prod -> reranker-v1 -> gen-xl-fp16.
Liang Platform: reranker-v1 has a known mem hotspot when batch size spikes on long contexts. We should temporarily route GB to reranker-v1-quant (lower mem) or bypass reranker for critical webhooks until fix.
Olivia CSM: customer is sensitive to latency but also to cost. They asked for a short-term fix + ETA for root cause.
Sam Eng: short-term plan: 1) route webhooks to reranker-v1-quant for eu region (temporary) 2) patch worker autoscaler thresholds to scale earlier 3) roll a hotfix to reranker batch logic. I can take 1+2 now.
Sam Eng: pinging @Liang Platform for the routing config change and to confirm no infra-side regression.
Liang Platform: I can do the route change and autoscale tweak. Will push a safe config with 15 min cooldown and smaller batch cap. Doing it now — will monitor.
Maya Support: I'll notify GreenBridge success team and offer a temporary SLA credit if they want — will hold until we confirm stability.
deploy-bot: config-change:route-override applied to eu1 for customer=greenbridge at 1835120402 by Liang Platform.
Sam Eng: verified reduced queue lengths after route change. Queue wait dropped from ~3s to ~120ms within 4m. No errors seen in last 8m.
Olivia CSM: awesome. Can you confirm if this will affect cost materially? Customer will ask.
Liang Platform: switching to quant reranker reduces inference memory and CPU, slight latency increase (~+20ms p50) but reduces cost per request ~18%. Good trade for now.
Sam Eng: blocker: we still need a code change to avoid batch spike for long contexts — I want to open a PR and request quick review. Minimal change: cap batchwise total tokens and fall back earlier.
Sam Eng: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/reranker/pull/482 — small change, tests included. Can someone from eng review? cc @Maya Support for staging test access.
Maya Support: will run the customer staging flow after PR merges.
Olivia CSM: for renewal team: plan = stabilize production w/route override (done), autoscale tweak (done), patch PR for reranker code (in flight, Sam owner). ETA for full rollback to normal routing: 48–72h after PR validated. I'll flag in renewal notes.
Sam Eng: today: open PR, fix unit tests if CI complains, coordinate hotfix deploy window (prefer low traffic hours). Blockers: need 1 reviewer from eng-runtime and a green canary on staging.
Liang Platform: today: monitor eu1 6h, run canary on staging with new autoscale settings. Blockers: none immediate.
Maya Support: today: schedule 30-min sync with GreenBridge (prefer 10:00 CET tomorrow), prepare incident postmortem draft for adoption team.
Olivia CSM: thanks. Action items: Sam = PR + deploy; Liang = routing + autoscale verification; Maya = customer comms + staging test; Olivia = renewal update.
Sam Eng: ack, starting PR review ping to eng-runtime.
Maya Support: quick note for docs: add a KB entry for "reranker memory spikes" under /support/runbooks. I'll draft.
Olivia CSM: that's it for async check. I'll update thread when PR merges or if customer requests call earlier. :thumbsup:
